intro: Games spotted during research that aren't in the guide yet, usually because their build process isn't documented. Any of them can be researched and added.

items.name: Eyrie
items.note: Co-op wave-based roguelike shooter. Vibe Jam 2026 "Most Atmospheric".
items.status: Credited to Claude Code by one curated list.

items.name: Dust Corridor
items.note: Playable market-street tactical FPS built from a ~20-section spec with Opus 5 in Cursor.
items.status: Covered inside the Claude of Duty entry; could get its own page.

items.name: Orcs in the Forest
items.note: Browser FPS hosted as a Hugging Face Space.

items.name: Silicon Pantheon
items.note: Turn-based tactics game where AI agents are first-class players.

items.name: Hanafuda card game (hogwartz.inc)
items.note: Polished Godot card game shipped in two days with Claude.

items.name: Warlord
items.note: Top-down war game where a local LLM commands the enemy army; vibe-coded in about two hours.
items.status: Checked Nov 2026: a public repo with a CLAUDE.md and a stage-by-stage devlog (Excalibur.js, Colyseus, an Ollama "mistral" commander, asset-pack art), but no public build or screenshots.

items.name: Hollowlands
items.note: MMO survival game, a top Colyseus game of Vibe Jam 2026.

items.name: Spellwright
items.note: Wizard arena where you prompt your own spells.

items.name: FULL SEND
items.note: Instant-loading 2D racer with OpenStreetMap scenery by @dvassallo. Vibe Jam 2026 "Most Portal Transfers".
items.status: Credited to Cursor + Claude by a curated list.

items.name: Kanso
items.note: Bonsai cultivation game. Vibe Jam 2026 "Most Zen".

items.name: HALDANE-4
items.note: ASCII horror game. Vibe Jam 2026 "Most Original".

items.name: Emberwick (Simon Willison)
items.note: 15-minute three.js RPG whose story and dialogue are all model-generated, built in regular Claude chat.
items.status: Easy add; documented on Simon's blog.

items.name: Raccoon Heist (Simon Willison)
items.note: 3D browser game from a single prompt.
items.status: Easy add; documented on Simon's blog.

items.name: Duckov Explorer
items.note: Claimed a fully AI-made pipeline: GPT concept art → Fast3D image-to-3D → one rigged GLB in Three.js, code by Cursor + Claude.
items.status: Checked Nov 2026: the play domain has expired and the only source is one anonymous Product Hunt post. It was a prototype with one model and red-cube enemies.

items.name: Grumbulus
items.note: Browser game by two developers with Claude Code: ~15k lines of vanilla JS with procedural audio.

items.name: Messenger (Abeto)
items.note: Gorgeous tiny-planet multiplayer three.js world. Not vibe-coded: it's fully hand-made, which makes it a useful contrast.
